summary: Eliminate __pending__ agent sessions. Trigger bubble shows model picker inline; on pick, create a fully-initialized session and prefill composer with task context as an editable draft. User hits Enter to send.

criteria.text: Server POST /agent-sessions rejects requests where agentId === '__pending__' OR where agentId is null/empty. No code path can produce a pending session anymore.
criteria.test_id: issue-653-c1: createSession rejects __pending__ and null agentId

criteria.text: Server agent_sessions_controller no longer appends a role='system' task-context message on session create (the #629 backend seed is removed). New sessions have ZERO persisted messages at insert time.
criteria.test_id: issue-653-c2: new session has no auto-seeded system message

criteria.text: Client trigger bubble (_ExpandedTriggerBubble) renders an inline UnifiedAgentModelPicker. The 'Open chat' CTA is disabled until a model is picked.
criteria.test_id: issue-653-c3: trigger bubble shows inline model picker; CTA disabled without selection

criteria.text: Clicking 'Open chat' with a model selected calls AgentsController.createSession with a non-null agentId resolved from the picked provider, plus providerId and modelId. Never null, never '__pending__'.
criteria.test_id: issue-653-c4: Open chat sends resolved agentId/providerId/modelId to createSession

criteria.text: After session creation from a trigger, the composer's text input is prefilled with '<task.title>\n<task.notes>' (or just title if notes is empty/null) and the input is focused. The text is in the controller, NOT persisted as a message yet.
criteria.test_id: issue-653-c5: composer is prefilled with task context after trigger open

criteria.text: User types/edits the prefilled text, hits Enter, the message sends as a normal user turn. The text the agent receives matches what the user committed (not a server-generated 'I need help with:' template, not a system seed).
criteria.test_id: issue-653-c6: edited composer text sends as user turn

criteria.text: Manual smoke (post-merge): add Visalia CRC as collaborator on a task; bubble appears with model picker; pick Claude; click Open chat; Agents view opens with the composer prefilled with the task title + notes; hit Enter; agent responds normally.

Code-level guard: ripgrep for '__pending__' in apps/ returns ONLY (a) the WS gateway's rejection branch that 400s legacy clients sending agentId='__pending__', (b) a single migration/tolerance comment explaining historical rows. No active business logic special-cases the sentinel.
criteria.test_id: issue-653-c8: rg '__pending__' returns only deprecation rejection + historical comment

not_tested: Behavior for existing __pending__ rows already in the production DB. These are sessions the user created in the broken state — they'll either be auto-closed via a one-shot migration, or left as historical noise with a 'session closed: agent never picked' label. Decision pending.
Multi-window race: opening two trigger bubbles at the same time and racing the model pick. Unlikely UX; deferred.
